label: answers
title: Sovereign Website Answers
description: Ask a question; a browser-only agent searches, reads the sources, asks several models and answers with every source and its date, saying how sure it is.
conditions: Static only, no server of ours. Keys and tokens held in the browser only (memory by default, localStorage only on the visitor's opt-in), sent only to their own provider. A CSP limited to self, openrouter.ai and the Google API hosts used. Fetched pages and model answers are treated as data, never instruction. An ABP. A security read of the key handling before anything goes public.
